title: 안경점에서 안경 맞추기: 가벼우니까 좋아요
objective: Ask for new glasses and give a reason with -으니까/-니까.
summary: Ask for new glasses and choose frames.
setting: A customer walks into an optician's shop because they cannot see well anymore.

task.title: Use the eye shop Korean
task.line: Choose, fill in, or write the Korean, using the words and -으니까/-니까 from page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling also got glasses made here.
Please take an eye test first.
The lens of my glasses broke.
I came to pick up my glasses.

words.meaning: because, so. After a vowel: -니까 (쓰니까). After a consonant: -으니까 (없으니까). ㅂ-words: 가볍다 → 가벼우니까
words.exampleMeaning: It's raining, so take an umbrella.

dialogue.korean: 요즘 멀리 있는 글씨가 잘 안 보여요. 새 안경을 맞추고 싶어요.
dialogue.meaning: These days I can't see letters far away very well. I'd like to get new glasses made.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 먼저 시력 검사를 할게요. 여기 앉으세요.
dialogue.meaning: Then I'll do an eye test first. Please sit here.

dialogue.korean: 전보다 눈이 조금 나빠졌어요. 안경테는 어떤 걸 찾으세요?
dialogue.meaning: Your eyesight has got a little worse than before. What kind of frames are you looking for?

dialogue.korean: 매일 오래 쓰니까 가벼운 테가 좋아요.
dialogue.meaning: I wear them for a long time every day, so I'd like light frames.

dialogue.korean: 이 테는 어떠세요? 가벼우니까 코가 안 아파요.
dialogue.meaning: How about these frames? They're light, so your nose won't hurt.

dialogue.korean: 좋네요. 이걸로 할게요. 언제 찾을 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: These are nice. I'll take these. When can I pick them up?

dialogue.korean: 지금 주문이 많으니까 한 시간 후에 오세요.
dialogue.meaning: There are a lot of orders right now, so come back in an hour.

exercises: Choose the right form: 이 안경테는 (무거우니까 / 무겁으니까) 다른 걸 보여 주세요.
Fill in the blank with -으니까/-니까 (작다): 이 가게는 ____ 안경테가 별로 없어요.
Fill in each blank with 렌즈, 안경테, or 시력 검사: ① 눈이 얼마나 나쁜지 알고 싶어요. 먼저 ____를 해요. ② 안경 유리가 깨졌어요. ____를 바꿔요. ③ 빨간색 ____가 예뻐요. 코가 안 아파요.
Say it in Korean with -으니까/-니까: You can't see well, so you want an eye test.
answers: ① 시력 검사 ② 렌즈 ③ 안경테
잘 안 보이니까 시력 검사를 하고 싶어요. (잘 안 보이니까 시력 검사를 받고 싶어요.)
